didNotCatch: Sorry, I did not catch that. Please say it again.
interpreterOffered: Not sure of this translation. A human interpreter is offered.
interpreterAvailable: A human interpreter is offered for this conversation.
explainBackListening: Please tell the doctor, in your own words, how you will follow the plan.
explainBackChecking: Thank you. The doctor is checking.

summaryRefused: Your summary needs the doctor's check. It is not ready yet.

refusedBusy: Please wait a moment, then try again.
refusedNotCurrent: This changed. Please check the latest version.
refusedGeneric: That could not be done. Please try again.

signalRepeatNotice: Saying the last sentence again for the patient.
